extensions.northStar: A precise, light atmospheric forecast sheet that makes the current state, next 72 hours, and modeled drivers immediately legible.
rules: Flat warm-neutral surfaces; no gradients, glass, or glow.
Cobalt identifies forecast focus and active controls; violet identifies inversion; brown identifies smoke influence.
Use plain language and visible status labels to distinguish replay, synthetic values, schematic geography, and prototype intervals from live or validated evidence.
Keep the map and time horizon primary; support station-level inspection without obscuring replay state.

motion.interaction: Use 180–240ms ease-out transitions for selection, drawer reveal, and control feedback. Avoid animating large data surfaces.
motion.reducedMotion: Disable nonessential transitions and smooth scrolling when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

breakpoints.mobile: 680px and below: horizontal KPI strip, compact top navigation, sticky forecast time control.
breakpoints.tablet: 681px–1040px: condensed rail and stacked station context.
breakpoints.desktop: Above 1040px: persistent rail, map workspace, and station insight column.

elevation.floating: Subtle shadow for tooltip and sticky mobile time control only.

components.primaryAction: Rectangular cobalt surface, white label, 44px minimum touch height.
components.forecastMetric: Tabular number, explicit unit, compact uppercase label, category word beside AQI.
components.selectedStation: Square cobalt selection frame with a visible label and keyboard focus outline.
components.uncertainty: Flat pale blue interval beneath a cobalt median trace; label the interval as prototype unless calibrated.
